Description: % of enrolled users who started at least one session in the period
Source column(s) / field(s): r_user.client_id (denominator: COUNT(*) WHERE client_id); r_user_session.user_id, r_user_session.date_created (numerator: COUNT DISTINCT user_id in date range)
Notes: Enrolled = all-time headcount for the client; Active = users with >=1 session inside the selected date range. Goal is a fixed 80% (Sugerencia de KPI's Cesar.xlsx spec) -- not derived from data.
Counts weeks that had at least one session anywhere in the client -- not per-user weeks.

Description: % of enrolled users active in the last 30 days (fixed window, independent of the dashboard date filter)
Source column(s) / field(s): r_user_session.user_id, r_user_session.date_created (window: last 30 days ending at the filter's "to" date)
Notes: Recency window is always exactly 30 days back from the selected range's end date -- widening the dashboard's date filter does not widen this window.

Description: Average change in score between a user's first and last scored session in the period
Formula: AVG(last_score - first_score) per user, across users with >=2 scored sessions
Source column(s) / field(s): r_user_session.user_id, date_created, raw_closing_data / closing_analysis (score extracted via SCORE_SQL -- see below)
Notes: Users with only 1 scored session in the period contribute nothing (no delta to compute).

Description: % of enrolled users who reached mastery (score >=95) in at least one session in the period
Notes: Mastery threshold (95) is a code constant (MASTERY_THRESHOLD), not user-configurable.

Description: Buckets every scored session by score band
Notes: Buckets sessions, not users -- one user can land in multiple buckets across sessions.

Description: % of sessions where the evaluator's own field records a positive shift in the rep's stance
Formula: 100 * positive-movement sessions / sessions with the field present
Notes: Returns no data (not 0%) for any client/session whose evaluator template doesn't produce this field -- never fabricated.

Source column(s) / field(s): raw_closing_data JSON fields matching pattern 'bloque_<name>_score' (discovered by regex per session, not a hardcoded list)
Notes: Which domains exist varies per client/evaluator template -- this is why domain names differ across clients.

Description: Filters every query above to one training module
Source column(s) / field(s): r_simulator.category (values: SIM, COACH, SEGMENT/CERTIFICATION -- 4th internal value exists but only these 3 are user-facing); r_user_session.simulator_id joins to r_simulator.ID
Notes: Dashboard labels these as ""Simulator"" / ""Master Coach"" / ""Certifier Coach"" -- the underlying schema's own names differ from what's shown on screen.

KPI / Metric: Session score (used by several KPIs above)
Description: The single score value extracted per session
Formula: CASE expression trying several known evaluator template formats in order, first match wins
Source column(s) / field(s): raw_closing_data (JSON: score_bar or overall_score keys) as first choice, falling back to regex-parsing raw HTML in closing_analysis (several known CSS-class markers, one per legacy template)
Notes: This is the one formula every KPI above ultimately depends on. Sessions whose evaluator output matches none of the known formats return NULL score, not 0 -- they're excluded, not counted as failing.

Description: Total learners enrolled in this client's LearnWorlds school
Formula: Direct count from the LearnWorlds API
Source table(s): NOT a SQL table -- external LearnWorlds REST API
Notes: Different data source entirely from every KPI above. This is why its card can show "of 89 users across 196 enrollments · 5 Courses" -- LearnWorlds returns that composition directly; the Cesar SQL KPIs above don't have an equivalent roster breakdown available from the source query, which is the real reason those cards don't show a similar sub-label today.

Formula: Direct value from the LearnWorlds API per course
Source table(s): NOT a SQL table -- external LearnWorlds REST API
Notes: Same external source as Enrolled Users above -- current-state snapshot, no historical comparison stored, hence "noComparison" on this card.
